## Summary

Describe change and user-visible behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `rtk go test ./...`
- [ ] `rtk go build ./cmd/runny`
- [ ] Updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] Updated documentation, flags, config examples, or release notes when needed.
- [ ] Added terminal capture for visible TUI changes.

## Security

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private paths, or `.runny/runs/` artifacts included.
- [ ] GitHub Actions, Docker images, and dependencies remain pinned when changed.
